scope: Research-only review of AC1021/R21 page transform distinctions, current local page decoding/raw-section capture, and LibreDWG peer revision provenance.

primary_spec.source: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
findings: Page compression and Reed-Solomon encoding are separate transforms; a page may be uncompressed while still RS-coded.
The section encoding value identifies interleaved versus non-interleaved RS layout (4 versus 1), not a per-page RS-present flag.
The inspected specification text does not fully define a raw-versus-RS detector for every page profile.

libredwg_pr_1363.result: The PR reports an AC1021 fix for RS-coded pages whose compressed and uncompressed sizes are equal, and describes a small set of apparently verbatim metadata pages distinguished by physical-page-size geometry.
libredwg_pr_1363.limits: Peer-reported results on named samples; not a universal raw-page rule, a local reproduction, or independent per-handle semantic evidence.

libredwg_issue_1361.note: The reported extreme LWPOLYLINE values were attributed to R2007 page decoding rather than entity grammar.

libredwg_issue_1357.status: Still open on GitHub; reporter verified master behavior after related R2007 fixes
libredwg_issue_1357.note: The suspected causal link to PR 1363 was not bisected and remains an inference.

peer_version_boundary.policy: Do not treat 0.14.1 as containing the later AC1021 page fix; pin and verify an exact later commit for any optional comparison.

local_source_audit.observation: dwgReader21::parseDataPage accepts the AC1018 page format separately and otherwise RS-decodes before its compressed/stored decision. captureRawDwgDataSections passes prototype, VBA, and unknown sections through this decoder. A focused source search found no direct generated R21 page-envelope matrix in the selected existing test files.
local_source_audit.classification: Potential valid-page coverage gap; no local input was run and no libdxfrw defect is claimed.

recommended_generated_cases: ODA-/producer-qualified raw/no-RS page in a captured optional or unknown section
Malformed page geometry/encoding refusal and same-reader reuse
plan_update.validation_policy: Use the existing strict reader-matrix target and focused selector; defer broad matrices, sanitizer work, and one exact-pinned peer run to their existing composed gates.

fixture_policy: No external DWG/DXF was downloaded or committed. Future test controls are to be generated from scratch in the existing test owner; no CTest registration or dependency is added.

validation.reason: Research and plan refinement only; no production code changed.
